label: A source-nature basis for modes, ranked production and scoped cognitive dependence
term: source-based mode grounding and cognitive dependence in a selected explanatory fragment
definition: PositiveControl.SourceBasedAccount personal value requires coherence and factivity of a world-indexed PSR Arena; a sound, world-immanent, necessitating source-nature maker; all-world mode and ranking facts with positive nature-to-mode and nature-to-ranking explanation paths; an effect-absent world; nonnecessitation of explanation; strict fact priority; and ranking-to-exercise and exercise-to-recipient relevance in the SAME frame. Primitive contributions generate the relation by transitive closure. In Certificate the personal row routes the nature path through the sole represented cognition fact; the impersonal row has no paths from that fact to modes or ranking and no Apprehends instances. Cognition is bound to OneActApprehendsModes. The production mechanism also requires a primitive contingent exercise condition; flattening the value table removes its giving exercise.
note: Analyst interpretation, attribution deferred. Positive explanations and a sound maker restore commitments absent from appNone alone. The asserted nature/table relevance, non-composition and exhaustiveness of this sole-cognition explanatory fragment remain OPEN. No other cognition facts or kinds of dependence are represented. Necessary source existence and at-most-one real constituent are inherited from SharedIntrinsicStructure, not identified with all metaphysical simplicity. The flattened control changes giving only, without re-explaining the retained effect-existence field. The nature/mode truth equalities reduce definitionally for any supplied table; the absence of cognition-to-mode/rank paths follows from false cognition plus factivity. The added formal content is the selected positive source-nature graph and rank-sensitive giving, not an independent derivation of profile determination or mind-independence.
